threshold_rule: For each affordance and prompt separately, among thresholds with calibration negative-object alarm rate <= 0.10, maximize mean per-positive-object point recall; tie-break by lower negative alarm rate, then higher threshold.
calibration: 40 positive and 40 negative OpenAD train shapes per affordance; calibration IDs are the deterministic E15 IDs; original-query scores reused from E15 and selected-paraphrase scores generated in E16.
test: 40 positive and 40 negative OpenAD train shapes per affordance, deterministically selected from IDs disjoint from all calibration IDs; query thresholds frozen before test scoring.
scope_note: The provided model is pretrained on Affogato and is not fine-tuned on OpenAD. E16 uses a new object-disjoint calibration/test split carved from OpenAD train. This is cross-dataset exploratory evaluation, not an official Espresso or Affogato benchmark.
false_alarm_definition: A negative object is flagged if any point score is >= threshold.
sample_design: Balanced, affordance-stratified object sample; does not estimate natural prevalence.

grab.original_query: Point to the part you would grab.
grab.selected_paraphrase: Point to the part you would grasp.

pour.original_query: Point to the part you would use to pour.
pour.selected_paraphrase: Point to the part used for pouring.

wrap.original_query: Point to the part you can wrap your hand around.
wrap.selected_paraphrase: Point to the region designed to be held by wrapping your hand around it.

accommodate.original_query: Point to the part of the object that can hold something.
accommodate.selected_paraphrase: Point to the part where you would place or keep something.

unlock.original_query: Point to the part you would use to unlock this object.
unlock.selected_paraphrase: Point to the part you would operate to gain access.
